title: U.S. OCCUPATION OF KOREA
producer: War Department, Bureau of Public Relations (Official U.S. Army Signal Corps Motion Pictures, Overseas Section)
nara_description: Japanese troops in Korea are disarmed by the U.S. forces and moved toward ports of embarkation. Shows stacks of arms confiscated from the Japanese. U.S. troops march and motorized columns roll through Seoul. A Korean speaker welcomes the Americans. Shows tents of U.S. forces bivouaced in the city's square and a closeup of U.S. soldiers around a machine gun.
licence: Public domain: US federal government work (17 U.S.C. § 105), filmed by US military personnel on duty; also out of term in Korea (films: 70 years from publication).
not_used: NARA items marked 'Restricted - Possibly' (e.g. the 111-ADC Signal Corps reels) were not used.
